interpretation: Prediction-error selection advances only if its credited memories reappear sooner and/or at better future Stanford retrieval ranks than a distribution-matched yoked-shuffle control by at least 0.05 in the median locked seed, with a positive delta in at least 6 of 8 seeds. This test uses exact Stanford node importance and creation-time metadata from the pinned Community artifact, while retrieval score remains a rank proxy because Stanford did not persist raw retrieval scores.
limitations: A positive result permits another offline causal test only. It does not permit live Endogenous Workspace activation. A negative result rejects this prediction-error selection rule under the pinned evidence source, not prediction-error mechanisms in general.
